on:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: builds-release-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions: {}

jobs:
  verify-source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Verify current main source
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Require exact current branch and successful push CI
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        DISPATCH_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
        DISPATCH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      run: bash ./Tools/verify-g4-release-source.sh

  release:
    needs: verify-source
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Release
    environment: ${{ github.ref_name == 'prerelease' && 'prerelease' || 'production' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write        # push tag and create GitHub release
      issues: write          # semantic-release comments on released issues
      pull-requests: write   # semantic-release comments on released PRs
      packages: write        # publish future tool packages to GitHub Packages
      actions: read          # verify exact-SHA push CI after protected approval
      id-token: write         # exchange GitHub OIDC identity for a temporary NuGet.org key
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        persist-credentials: false

    - name: Initialize .NET
      uses: ./Github/initialize-dotnet
      with:
        global-json-file: global.json

    # Exact-SHA push CI owns source tests and regression suites. Only the actual
    # release version is built and qualified by the semantic-release lifecycle.
    - name: Initialize runner NuGet configuration
      shell: bash
      run: install -D -m 600 test/fixtures/package-consumer/NuGet.Config "$HOME/.nuget/NuGet/NuGet.Config"

    - name: Recheck approved release source and push CI
      id: approved_source
      shell: bash
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        DISPATCH_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
        DISPATCH_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      run: bash ./Tools/verify-g4-release-source.sh

    - name: Authenticate to NuGet.org with Trusted Publishing
      if: github.ref_name != 'prerelease'
      id: nuget_login
      uses: NuGet/login@8d196754b4036150537f80ac539e15c2f1028841 # v1.2.0
      with:
        user: ${{ vars.NUGET_USER }}

    - name: Create Release
      id: create_release
      uses: ./Github/create-release
      env:
        HEXALITH_G4_SOURCE_CI_RUN_ID: ${{ steps.approved_source.outputs.ci-run-id }}
      with:
        github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        nuget-api-key: ${{ steps.nuget_login.outputs.NUGET_API_KEY }}

    - name: Record release qualification attempt
      if: always()
      env:
        G4_PRODUCER_STEP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.create_release.outcome }}
      run: python3 Tools/archive-g4-qualification-evidence.py --package-directory artifacts/g4-tool-packages --kind release --record-attempt

    - name: Retain actual-version qualification evidence
      if: always()
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
      with:
        name: g4-release-qualification-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        path: |
          artifacts/g4-tool-packages/producer-attempt.json
          artifacts/g4-tool-packages/**/g4-tool-qualification-evidence.zip
          artifacts/g4-tool-packages/**/g4-tool-package-inventory.json
          artifacts/g4-tool-packages/**/qualification-evidence/
        if-no-files-found: warn
        retention-days: 90
'
